spec.title: Connection win rates per message type

spec.query:
SELECT last(conn_id) as conn_id, sum(first) as wins, sum(dup) as losses FROM "XdpConnDedup"
WHERE $timeFilter AND ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/
GROUP BY time(1m), conn_slot, msg_type fill(none)

SELECT last(conn_id) as conn_id, sum(first) as wins, sum(dup) as losses FROM "XdpConnDedup"
WHERE $timeFilter AND ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/
GROUP BY time(1m), conn_slot, msg_type fill(none)

SELECT last(conn_id) as conn_id, last(dst_ip) as dst_ip, sum(tcp_seq_gaps) as gaps FROM XdpConnStats
WHERE $timeFilter AND ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/
GROUP BY time(1m), conn_slot fill(none)

SELECT last(conn_id) as conn_id
FROM "FeedChanFeedMsg"
WHERE $timeFilter AND("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/ and channel  =~ /^$Channel$/ and "feed" =~ /^$FeedSet/
GROUP BY channel, conn_slot, feed fill(none)

SELECT 100 * (sum(wins) / (sum(wins) + sum(losses))) as win_rate, last(conn_id) as conn_id
FROM
(
 SELECT sum("first") as wins, sum("dup") as losses , last(conn_id) as conn_id FROM "XdpConnDedup"
 WHERE $timeFilter AND ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/
 GROUP BY time($AggregationWindow), conn_slot, role fill(none)
)
WHERE (wins + losses) > 0
GROUP BY time($AggregationWindow), conn_slot, role fill(none)

SELECT sum(count) as wins, last(conn_id) as conn_id
FROM "FeedChanFeedMsg"
WHERE $timeFilter and ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/ and "channel" =~ /$Channel/ and feed =~ /^$FeedSet/
GROUP BY time($AggregationWindow), conn_slot, role, feed fill(none)

SELECT last(dst_ip) as dst_ip, last(conn_id) as conn_id
FROM
(
SELECT last(conn_id) as conn_id, last(dst_ip) as dst_ip FROM XdpConnStats
WHERE $timeFilter AND ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/
GROUP BY time(1m), conn_slot, role fill(none)
)
GROUP BY time(1m), conn_slot, role fill(none)

SELECT sum(count) as wins, last(conn_id) as conn_id
FROM "FeedChanFeedMsg"
WHERE $timeFilter and role =~ /$FeedRole/ AND ("host" =~ /^$Host$/) AND "endpoint" =~ /^$Endpoint$/ AND "role" =~ /^$FeedRole$/ and "channel" =~ /$Channel/ and feed =~ /^$FeedSet/
GROUP BY time(1m), conn_slot, role, feed fill(none)
